name: xiao-ui-theme-ts
author: jinxlux
description: Customizable theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness web UI. Ships with a Xiao-style jade palette by default; accent color, mascot badge text, injected voice and frosted background are all configurable. Built with TypeScript and pnpm.

dsh.note: 0.12.0 targets DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 and newer (native right panel + new sidebar). On 0.1.5-rc.1 and older, install theme 0.11.x instead - the one-layer-per-region painting model does not line up with their right side once better-sidebar is installed.

betterSidebar.legacy: <=0.18 is not adapted to any more; legacy anchors stay in the CSS so nothing crashes, but the look is not guaranteed. Use theme 0.11.x for those installs.

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');fs.rmSync('lib',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.rmSync('.build',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.build-host.json && tsc -p tsconfig.build-client.json && node scripts/wrap-client.mjs
scripts.test: pnpm run build && node test/host.test.mjs && node test/client.test.mjs
